# Plan

Liu 2026 links METTL13 / eEF1A K55me2 to KRAS-driven cancers. Two questions, in control
(siCTRL, normoxia) cells:

1. Is **KRAS** itself highly expressed in MDA-MB-231 or MCF7-SIX1?
2. Is the **KRAS transcriptional program** (MSigDB `HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_UP`) higher in one
   line than the other?

**Samples.** siCTRL normoxia RNA-seq (not ribo-seq):

- MDA-MB-231: `Input_Ribo_RNAseq` at 1hr and 4hr, 3 reps each (`metadata_231_timecourse.csv`).
- MCF7-SIX1: NM2023_0104 / 0114 / 0124 (rRNA-depletion, KAPA RNA HyperPrep).

**The two lines were not quantified the same way.** MCF7-SIX1 used a GENCODE v26 Salmon index;
MDA-MB-231 used a newer index with *Drosophila* spike-in and decoy sequences; the library preps
differ. Raw TPM is therefore **not directly comparable between lines**. The primary readout is
each gene's **percentile within its own sample**, which is unaffected by those differences.
Cross-line TPM is shown, labelled as indicative.

**Gene TPM.** Each line's transcript TPM is mapped to genes with **its own index's
annotation**: GENCODE v49 (`txdb.gencode49.sqlite`) for MDA-MB-231, and the other repo's
`gencode.v26.primary.info.csv.gz` for MCF7-SIX1. Mapping the v26 transcripts through v49 loses
every transcript retired since v26; a first version did that and put ACTB at 40 TPM in MCF7,
because its main v26 isoform (ENST00000331789, 921 TPM) no longer exists in v49. TPM is then
summed per gene, matched on version-stripped Ensembl gene ID, restricted to protein-coding genes
(v49 definition) quantified in both lines, and renormalized to 1e6 per sample. That removes fly,
rRNA and other non-coding signal.

# Load and quantify

```{r load}
mda_dir  <- here("2025_MDAcells_riboseq", "salmon")
mcf7_dir <- "/Users/katematlin/github/2024_eIF3e_hypoxia/2024_eIF3e_hypoxia/salmon"

meta_231 <- read_csv(here("accessories", "metadata_231_timecourse.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(id = 1) %>%
  filter(type == "Input_Ribo_RNAseq", treatment == "siCTRL", condition == "normoxia", hours %in% c(1, 4))
samples <- bind_rows(
  meta_231 %>% transmute(sample = id, cell_line = "MDA-MB-231", rep, hours,
                         path = file.path(mda_dir, id, "quant.sf.gz")),
  tibble(sample = c("NM2023_0104", "NM2023_0114", "NM2023_0124"), cell_line = "MCF7-SIX1",
         rep = c("RepA", "RepB", "RepC"), hours = 1,
         path = file.path(mcf7_dir, sample, "quant.sf.gz")))
stopifnot(nrow(samples) == 9, all(file.exists(samples$path)),
          sum(samples$cell_line == "MDA-MB-231") == 6)
knitr::kable(samples %>% dplyr::select(-path))

strip <- function(x) sub("\\..*", "", x)

txdb <- loadDb(here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))
tx2gene <- list(
  "MDA-MB-231" = AnnotationDbi::select(txdb, keys(txdb, "TXNAME"), c("TXNAME", "GENEID"), "TXNAME") %>%
    transmute(tx = strip(TXNAME), gene_id = strip(GENEID)),
  "MCF7-SIX1" = read_csv(file.path(dirname(mcf7_dir), "accessories", "gencode.v26.primary.info.csv.gz"),
                         col_names = c("gene_id", "tx", "biotype", "symbol"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(!str_detect(tx, "^pre_"), !str_detect(tx, "_PAR_Y")) %>%   # PAR_Y copies duplicate chrX IDs
    transmute(tx = strip(tx), gene_id = strip(gene_id)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tx2gene[[1]]$tx), !anyDuplicated(tx2gene[[2]]$tx))

anno <- read_tsv(here("accessories", "human", "gene_anno_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv"),
                 col_names = c("gene_id", "symbol", "type", "species", "source"), show_col_types = FALSE)
pc <- anno %>% filter(type == "protein_coding", species == "human") %>%
  distinct(gene_id = strip(gene_id), symbol)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(pc$gene_id))

gene_tpm_one <- function(path, line) {
  q <- read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(!str_detect(Name, "_PAR_Y")) %>%
    mutate(tx = strip(Name)) %>%
    left_join(tx2gene[[line]], by = "tx")
  attr_mapped <- sum(q$TPM[!is.na(q$gene_id)]) / sum(q$TPM)
  q %>% filter(gene_id %in% pc$gene_id) %>%
    group_by(gene_id) %>% summarise(tpm = sum(TPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(frac_tpm_mapped = attr_mapped)
}
raw <- samples %>% mutate(q = map2(path, cell_line, gene_tpm_one)) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, cell_line, q) %>% unnest(q)

raw %>% distinct(sample, cell_line, frac_tpm_mapped) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3,
  caption = "Fraction of each sample's TPM whose transcript maps to a gene in its own index annotation")
stopifnot(all(raw$frac_tpm_mapped[raw$cell_line == "MCF7-SIX1"] > 0.99))

# Protein-coding genes quantified in both lines (index versions differ)
shared <- raw %>% distinct(cell_line, gene_id) %>% dplyr::count(gene_id) %>% filter(n == 2) %>% pull(gene_id)

tpm <- raw %>%
  filter(gene_id %in% shared) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>% mutate(tpm = tpm / sum(tpm) * 1e6) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(pc, by = "gene_id") %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * percent_rank(tpm)) %>%   # percentile within sample
  ungroup()

cat("Protein-coding genes in both lines:", length(shared), "\n")
stopifnot(all(abs(tapply(tpm$tpm, tpm$sample, sum) - 1e6) < 1),
          "KRAS" %in% tpm$symbol)
```

# Checks

Cell-line identity and housekeeping spot-checks, so a swapped sample or a broken join cannot
pass silently. MCF7 is ER-positive and epithelial; MDA-MB-231 is ER-negative and mesenchymal.

```{r checks}
med <- tpm %>% group_by(cell_line, symbol) %>% summarise(tpm = median(tpm), pct = median(pct), .groups = "drop")
spot <- med %>% filter(symbol %in% c("ACTB", "GAPDH", "ESR1", "GATA3", "VIM", "CDH1", "KRAS")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cell_line, values_from = c(tpm, pct))
knitr::kable(spot, digits = 1)

get <- function(line, gene, col = "pct") med[[col]][med$cell_line == line & med$symbol == gene]
stopifnot(
  "ACTB / GAPDH should be top-percentile in every sample" =
    all(tpm$pct[tpm$symbol %in% c("ACTB", "GAPDH")] > 95),
  "ESR1 should be far higher in MCF7-SIX1 (ER+) than MDA-MB-231 (ER-)" =
    get("MCF7-SIX1", "ESR1") > 75 && get("MDA-MB-231", "ESR1") < 50,
  "VIM should be far higher in MDA-MB-231 (mesenchymal)" =
    get("MDA-MB-231", "VIM") > 90 && get("MDA-MB-231", "VIM", "tpm") > 10 * get("MCF7-SIX1", "VIM", "tpm")
)

# Replicates agree within a line
wide <- tpm %>% dplyr::select(sample, gene_id, tpm) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = tpm)
rep_cor <- cor(log2(as.matrix(wide[, -1]) + 1), method = "spearman")
print(round(rep_cor, 3))
for (line in unique(samples$cell_line)) {
  s <- samples$sample[samples$cell_line == line]
  stopifnot(min(rep_cor[s, s]) > 0.9)
}
```

# 1. KRAS expression

```{r kras, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 3.5}
kras <- tpm %>% filter(symbol == "KRAS") %>% left_join(samples %>% dplyr::select(sample, hours), by = "sample")
knitr::kable(kras %>% dplyr::select(cell_line, sample, hours, tpm, pct), digits = 1)

line_colors <- c("MDA-MB-231" = "#CC79A7", "MCF7-SIX1" = "#0072B2")

p_kras <- ggplot(kras, aes(cell_line, pct, colour = cell_line)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0, size = 2.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = line_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "KRAS percentile within sample",
       title = "KRAS mRNA, siCTRL normoxia",
       subtitle = sprintf("%d protein-coding genes\nmedian TPM %.1f (MDA-MB-231) vs %.1f (MCF7-SIX1)",
                          length(shared), median(kras$tpm[kras$cell_line == "MDA-MB-231"]),
                          median(kras$tpm[kras$cell_line == "MCF7-SIX1"]))) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
p_kras

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_08_kras_percentile.pdf"), p_kras, width = 6, height = 3.8)
```

# 2. KRAS transcriptional program

**Score.** For each sample, the mean within-sample percentile of the gene set's genes. A
percentile is unaffected by library prep and index, so scores are comparable across lines.
`HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_DN` (genes repressed by KRAS) is the internal contrast: an active
program should raise UP and not DN.

**Null.** The line difference in score (MDA-MB-231 minus MCF7-SIX1) for `r params$n_null`
random gene sets of the same size, drawn from the same shared protein-coding genes with
`set.seed(9)`. Empirical p = (k + 1) / (n + 1), two-sided.

```{r program}
hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")
sets <- list(KRAS_UP = "HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_UP", KRAS_DN = "HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_DN") %>%
  map(~ intersect(unique(hallmark$gene_symbol[hallmark$gs_name == .x]), tpm$symbol))
cat("Genes in data: KRAS_UP", length(sets$KRAS_UP), "| KRAS_DN", length(sets$KRAS_DN), "\n")
stopifnot(lengths(sets) > 150)

pct_mat <- tpm %>% filter(!is.na(symbol)) %>% distinct(sample, symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, symbol, pct) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = pct) %>%
  column_to_rownames("symbol") %>% as.matrix()
mda  <- samples$sample[samples$cell_line == "MDA-MB-231"]
mcf7 <- samples$sample[samples$cell_line == "MCF7-SIX1"]

line_diff <- function(genes) {
  s <- colMeans(pct_mat[genes, , drop = FALSE])
  mean(s[mda]) - mean(s[mcf7])
}

set.seed(9)
program <- imap_dfr(sets, function(genes, nm) {
  obs  <- line_diff(genes)
  null <- replicate(params$n_null, line_diff(sample(rownames(pct_mat), length(genes))))
  scores <- colMeans(pct_mat[genes, ])
  tibble(set = nm, n_genes = length(genes),
         mean_score_MDA = mean(scores[mda]), mean_score_MCF7 = mean(scores[mcf7]),
         diff_MDA_minus_MCF7 = obs,
         null_sd = sd(null),
         z = (obs - mean(null)) / sd(null),
         empirical_p = (sum(abs(null - mean(null)) >= abs(obs - mean(null))) + 1) / (params$n_null + 1))
})
knitr::kable(program, digits = 3)
```

```{r program_plot, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4}
gene_diff <- tibble(symbol = rownames(pct_mat),
                    diff = rowMeans(pct_mat[, mda]) - rowMeans(pct_mat[, mcf7])) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(symbol %in% sets$KRAS_UP ~ "KRAS signaling UP",
                           symbol %in% sets$KRAS_DN ~ "KRAS signaling DN",
                           TRUE ~ "All other genes"),
         group = factor(group, levels = c("KRAS signaling UP", "KRAS signaling DN", "All other genes")))
n_grp <- table(gene_diff$group)
grp_lab <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n = %s)", names(n_grp), format(as.integer(n_grp), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)),
                    names(n_grp))

# Empirical p cannot go below 1 / (n_null + 1); report it as a bound there
fmt_p <- function(p) if (p <= 1 / (params$n_null + 1)) sprintf("<= %.3g", p) else sprintf("= %.3g", p)

p_prog <- ggplot(gene_diff, aes(diff, colour = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("KRAS signaling UP" = "#D55E00", "KRAS signaling DN" = "#009E73",
                                 "All other genes" = "grey70"), labels = grp_lab, name = NULL) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.6, size = 3.2,
           label = sprintf("UP: diff %+.1f, null p %s\nDN: diff %+.1f, null p %s",
                           program$diff_MDA_minus_MCF7[1], fmt_p(program$empirical_p[1]),
                           program$diff_MDA_minus_MCF7[2], fmt_p(program$empirical_p[2]))) +
  labs(x = "Percentile in MDA-MB-231 minus MCF7-SIX1 (per gene)", y = "Cumulative fraction",
       title = "KRAS transcriptional program, siCTRL normoxia",
       subtitle = "Right of zero = higher in MDA-MB-231") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98), legend.justification = c(0, 1),
        legend.background = element_blank())
p_prog

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_08_kras_program_cdf.pdf"), p_prog, width = 7, height = 4)
```

# 3. KRAS program within each line

The plot above is a contrast between lines. This asks the question inside one line: where do
the KRAS UP and DN genes rank among all genes, using each gene's within-sample percentile
averaged over that line's replicates. All other genes sit near a uniform distribution (the
diagonal) by construction. An active program shows UP shifted right of all other genes and DN
shifted left. Gene sets are not expression-matched, so a set can sit right of the diagonal just by
containing well-expressed genes; the **gap between UP and DN** is the readable quantity.

```{r within_line, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4}
within_cdf <- function(line, cols) {
  fp <- function(p) { s <- format.pval(p, digits = 2); if (startsWith(s, "<")) s else paste("=", s) }
  df <- tibble(symbol = rownames(pct_mat), pct = rowMeans(pct_mat[, cols, drop = FALSE])) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(case_when(symbol %in% sets$KRAS_UP ~ "KRAS signaling UP",
                                    symbol %in% sets$KRAS_DN ~ "KRAS signaling DN",
                                    TRUE ~ "All other genes"),
                          levels = c("KRAS signaling UP", "KRAS signaling DN", "All other genes")))
  x <- split(df$pct, df$group)
  w_up <- wilcox.test(x[["KRAS signaling UP"]], x[["All other genes"]])
  w_dn <- wilcox.test(x[["KRAS signaling DN"]], x[["All other genes"]])
  w_ud <- wilcox.test(x[["KRAS signaling UP"]], x[["KRAS signaling DN"]])
  med  <- map_dbl(x, median)
  n    <- lengths(x)
  lab  <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n = %s)", names(n), format(n, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)), names(n))

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(pct, colour = group)) +
    stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("KRAS signaling UP" = "#D55E00", "KRAS signaling DN" = "#009E73",
                                   "All other genes" = "grey70"), labels = lab, name = NULL) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2,
             label = sprintf(paste0("median percentile: UP %.1f, DN %.1f, other %.1f\n",
                                    "Wilcoxon vs other: UP p %s, DN p %s\nUP vs DN p %s"),
                             med[["KRAS signaling UP"]], med[["KRAS signaling DN"]], med[["All other genes"]],
                             fp(w_up$p.value), fp(w_dn$p.value),
                             fp(w_ud$p.value))) +
    labs(x = sprintf("Within-sample expression percentile, %s (mean of %d reps)", line, length(cols)),
         y = "Cumulative fraction",
         title = sprintf("KRAS transcriptional program in %s", line),
         subtitle = "siCTRL normoxia; right = more highly expressed") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98), legend.justification = c(0, 1),
          legend.background = element_blank())
  list(plot = p, medians = med,
       p = c(UP_vs_other = w_up$p.value, DN_vs_other = w_dn$p.value, UP_vs_DN = w_ud$p.value))
}

within <- list(`MCF7-SIX1` = within_cdf("MCF7-SIX1", mcf7), `MDA-MB-231` = within_cdf("MDA-MB-231", mda))
stopifnot(abs(within[["MCF7-SIX1"]]$medians[["All other genes"]] - 50) < 2)   # uniform by construction

within[["MCF7-SIX1"]]$plot
within[["MDA-MB-231"]]$plot

imap_dfr(within, ~ tibble(line = .y, median_UP = .x$medians[["KRAS signaling UP"]],
                          median_DN = .x$medians[["KRAS signaling DN"]],
                          UP_minus_DN = .x$medians[["KRAS signaling UP"]] - .x$medians[["KRAS signaling DN"]],
                          p_UP_vs_other = .x$p[["UP_vs_other"]], p_DN_vs_other = .x$p[["DN_vs_other"]],
                          p_UP_vs_DN = .x$p[["UP_vs_DN"]])) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots)) {
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_08_kras_program_within_mcf7six1.pdf"), within[["MCF7-SIX1"]]$plot,
         width = 7, height = 4)
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_08_kras_program_within_mda231.pdf"), within[["MDA-MB-231"]]$plot,
         width = 7, height = 4)
}
```
